verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents default AI agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code), a menu-driven Install > Development section for setting up dev environments, and support/theme-matching for modern IDEs like VSCode, Cursor, Zed, Sublime, Helix, plus Lazygit for git workflows; community reports corroborate fast, smooth software installation on Arch. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of specific toolchain/AI-ML package versions and any benchmark of 'latest' version currency versus upstream Arch repos.
